name: Gorishi Queen Brain
summary: The Gorishi Queen Brain is a specimen taken from the queen in the Slithering Scar. Researchers in Gadgetzan want it to study the silithid and the force that may control them.

sections.title: A Mind to Study
sections.body: Researchers in Gadgetzan seek the Gorishi Queen Brain after the Gorishi Hive Queen is summoned from her chamber in southern Un'Goro Crater. They suspect the silithid may answer to a malign intelligence, and hope the queen's brain will help them understand it. Their findings may reveal more about the hive than its queen alone.

faq.q: What is the Gorishi Queen Brain?
faq.answer: The Gorishi Queen Brain is a specimen taken from the Gorishi Hive Queen for study by researchers in Gadgetzan.

faq.q: Where does the Gorishi Queen Brain come from?
faq.answer: It comes from the Gorishi Hive Queen in the Slithering Scar, in southern Un'Goro Crater.

faq.q: Why do researchers want the queen's brain?
faq.answer: Researchers in Gadgetzan hope the brain will help them understand the silithid and the malign intelligence they suspect may control them.

faq.q: How is the Gorishi Hive Queen summoned?
faq.answer: A Gorishi Queen Lure used on a crystal in the hive's hatcheries is meant to draw out the queen.

faq.q: Is the queen the only silithid presence?
faq.answer: The researchers doubt that the Gorishi Hive Queen marks the full extent of the silithid presence.
